title: Typing Titans
about:
Participants will be provided with a short and simple text passage to type within the allotted time.

Participants will be provided with a text passage containing letters, numbers, punctuation marks, and special characters.
rules:
Competition Format

The competition consists of two rounds. Each round carries 10 marks, making a total of 20 marks.

Round 1: Monkey Typing

  • The duration of this round is 2 minutes.
  • Participants must type the given passage as accurately and as quickly as possible.
  • Use of the Backspace key is strictly prohibited.
  • Spell-check, auto-correct, predictive text, grammar correction, or any similar assistance must be disabled.
  • Participants are expected to be familiar with the Monkey Typing format before the competition begins.
  • Any use of unauthorised typing assistance or violation of the rules will result in immediate disqualification.

Round 2: Blind Typing

  • The duration of this round is 2 minutes.
  • During typing, the display/monitor will remain blank, and participants will not be able to view the text being typed.
  • Participants must rely solely on their typing skills and memory.
  • The passage must be typed exactly as provided, including:
    • Uppercase and lowercase letters
    • Numbers
    • Punctuation marks
    • Special characters
  • Any attempt to bypass the blank screen or use unauthorised tools or techniques will result in immediate disqualification.

General Rules

  1. Each participant will be given 2 minutes for each round.
  2. Participants must use only the keyboard provided by the organisers.
  3. The use of Backspace is strictly prohibited in Round 1.
  4. Spell-check, auto-correct, predictive text, grammar assistance, macros, or any other typing aid must remain disabled throughout the competition.
  5. Participants must not use mobile phones, notes, smart devices, or any external assistance during the competition.
  6. Any attempt to manipulate the system, bypass the blank screen, or use unauthorised software or hardware will result in immediate disqualification.
  7. Participants are expected to maintain discipline and follow the instructions of the event coordinators at all times.
  8. Any technical issue must be reported immediately to the event officials. The organisers' decision regarding technical matters shall be final.
  9. Failure to comply with any of the above rules may lead to disqualification.

Winner Selection

  • The combined score from Round 1 and Round 2 (out of 20 marks) will determine the final rankings.
  • The top two participants with the highest overall scores will be declared the Winner and Runner-up.
  • In the event of a tie, the participant with the higher overall accuracy score will be given preference. If the tie still persists, the judges may conduct a tie-breaker round or decide based on additional criteria determined by the organising committee.

Decision of the Judges

The decision of the judges and the organising committee shall be final and binding in all matters related to the competition. No requests for re-evaluation or appeals will be entertained.
judging:
Each round carries 10 marks, distributed as follows:

Criteria

Marks

Speed

4 Marks

Accuracy

6 Marks

Total

10 Marks

Speed (4 Marks)

  • Marks will be awarded based on the number of words or characters correctly typed within the 2-minute time limit.

Accuracy (6 Marks)

  • Marks will be awarded based on the correctness of the typed text when compared with the original passage.
  • Accuracy includes:
    • Correct spelling
    • Correct sequence of characters
    • Correct punctuation
    • Correct use of numbers and special characters (where applicable)
